raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Anna of Hungary (wife of Andronikos II) as the daughter of Béla IV and Maria Laskarina, concluding Maria Laskarina was the maternal grandmother. This conflated two different historical figures named Anna of Hungary. The correct Anna (Byzantine empress) was the daughter of Stephen V and Elizabeth the Cuman. The error arose from insufficient disambiguation and cross-verification before drawing a conclusion.
